faqs.question: Zameen ya flat ki registry ka kya process hota hai?
faqs.answer: Tamam plots aur apartments direct Balochistan Land Revenue Department ke official register mein transfer hotay hain. Har purchase se pehle Haji Saud Zehri ki team file verification aur mutation clearance tasdeeq karti hai.

faqs.question: Quetta mein bijli aur meethay paani ka kya intezam hai?
faqs.answer: Bismillah Real Estate ke tamam residential projects mein dedicated sweet-water tube wells aur pre-installed solar hybrid power systems shamil hain takay loadshedding ya paani ki kami ka samna na ho.

faqs.question: Installment plans ya aasan aqsaat dastiyab hain?
faqs.answer: Ji haan! Select projects aur home schemes mein 1 saal se 3 saal tak aasan monthly aur quarterly installment plans available hain with immediate possession on down-payment.

faqs.question: Haji Saud Zehri se direct private meeting kaise schedule karein?
faqs.answer: Aap hamari website par 'Private Briefing' form submit karein ya direct WhatsApp / phone par rabta karein. Hamari office team aap ka exclusive VIP meeting time schedule karegi.
